summary: Tested TIFMAS & EMTF Deployment Log pages (frontend + backend). Fixed 2 critical bugs: (1) syntax error at bottom of TIFMASDeploymentLog.js (garbage line 't default TIFMASDeploymentLog;') that would prevent compile in strict mode, and (2) MongoDB update payload bug in POST /api/deployment-history that raised 500 'update only works with $ operators'. Also added missing data-testid attributes (tifmas-deployment-log, tifmas-log-title) to TIFMAS page. All 5 backend pytest cases pass. All frontend flows validated in Playwright: eligible counts (24 TIFMAS, 26 EMTF), title, checkboxes, deploy button enable/disable, search filtering, fair rotation banner.
action_items: None critical - all reported flows working after fixes. Optional: silence eslint warning about missing dependency 'fetchPersonnel' in useEffect (both TIFMAS and EMTF log files, line 74) by using useCallback or eslint-disable-next-line.
critical_code_review_comments: TIFMASDeploymentLog.js and EMTFDeploymentLog.js are ~430 lines each and virtually identical (95% duplication). Extract a shared <DeploymentLog type='TIFMAS'|'EMTF' /> component to comply with DRY.
POST /api/deployment-history returns only {message, id} - consider returning the full created object so frontends can update local state without an extra GET.
In deployments_routes.py create_deployment_history: personnel loop performs N sequential update_one awaits. For larger deployments consider bulk_write for performance.
useEffect on TIFMAS/EMTF pages has missing dependency warning - use useCallback for fetchPersonnel.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/deployment-tracker/TIFMASDeploymentLog.js (removed corrupt trailing line 't default TIFMASDeploymentLog;', added data-testid='tifmas-deployment-log' on main, added data-testid='tifmas-log-title' on h1)
/app/backend/routes/deployments_routes.py (fixed MongoDB update payload in create_deployment_history: moved updated_at into $set and merged last_tifmas_deploy/last_emtf_deploy into same $set)
seed_data_creation: Test deployment history records prefixed with TEST_ are created and immediately deleted in each POST test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment history POST endpoint had a MongoDB bug (mixing top-level fields with $-operators) that has been fixed. If new fields are added to the personnel-rotation update in deployments_routes.py::create_deployment_history, ensure they go inside $set. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_deployment_logs.py covers rotation ordering and deployment creation for both TIFMAS (24 eligible) and EMTF (26 eligible).
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (frontend): The TIFMAS log source file had an accidental duplicate/truncated line at EOF ('t default TIFMASDeploymentLog;') left over from an edit. It compiled with warnings under CRA's lenient mode but was invalid JS. Removed the garbage line. Bug 2 (backend): create_deployment_history built an update dict mixing top-level 'updated_at' with '$inc' and '$set' operators. PyMongo rejects any dict passed to update_one() that has both top-level fields and $-operators. Fix: moved 'updated_at' inside the '$set' operator and merged the type-specific last_*_deploy field into the same '$set' object. Reproduced with pytest POST to /api/deployment-history, verified 500 in backend logs (ValueError: 'update only works with $ operators' at deployments_routes.py:962), applied fix, re-ran tests - all pass.
